observations.finding: Project valid_name permits every nonempty ASCII alphanumeric/dash/underscore/dot string, including '.' and '..'. Native app.rs:157 dispatches 'package' directly to packages::run; link --name or positional name is checked by this validator, and a successful Cargo metadata/build yields an artifact before cwd/.ice/packages/name/extensions is created. '--name ..' can therefore direct the copy into cwd/.ice/extensions and persist '..' on registry success. unlink accepts the same validator, requires a matching registry record, then calls remove_dir_all on cwd/.ice/packages/name before rewriting the registry. The exact OS deletion effect of a trailing parent component is unexecuted and is not asserted. Cargo-derived selected.name goes through the same validator, but external Cargo package-name constraints were not independently established. JSON registry reads do not semantically validate stored names; project_package_dirs joins them unchecked. The global installer uses a stricter non-dot crate-name grammar.

run_bounded_process_blocking applies cap_bytes only after wait_with_output completes; its 10s timeout is real but the 4096-byte limit truncates retained output after collection, not memory/stream ingestion. Preserve exact bounds and propose streaming cap in correction; no runtime reproduction.

Rust status writer emits numeric updatedAtMs and consumer defaults missing updatedAtMs to 0; embedded PowerShell helper replaces the status with ISO updatedAt only. Real helper waiting/succeeded output therefore has unknown age for the >1h/>24h status TTL branches, unlike inline fixtures that supply updatedAtMs. Failed statuses remain consumed independent of timestamp; orphan/empty staging cleanup has separate rules. No Windows execution.

When !force and a valid staged version S is >= reported latest L, staged_wins selects S; returning 'already staged' is nevertheless nested under !is_newer(current,S). For current C < S and S >= L the code continues to prepare another update, contrary to comments claiming queued newer staging prevents duplicate work. Validation/availability prerequisites and platform effects must remain explicit; no execution.

prebuilt_release::REPOSITORY is the mixed-case constant https://github.com/Zyk-Void/ice-rust. canonical_repository lowercases owner and repository, so the validated manifest repository becomes https://github.com/zyk-void/ice-rust and cannot equal that constant in validate. Consequently an otherwise valid official CLI prebuilt manifest is rejected as repository mismatch before archive staging. The asset URL validator also compares a canonicalized repository against its supplied mixed-case constant. This conclusion follows from the visible string transformations; no update command or fixture was executed. The included happy-path fixture constructs the same mixed-case repository and would encounter the same comparison.
